notes: Seam chosen: the KANBAN ROW (docs/infra/managent/tasks.json), not the runner trailer. Rationale: dispatch/claim/show all operate on the kanban row (acceptance: `managent dispatch`/`claim` writes, `managent show` displays), and the runner trailer (untracked/runs/<task>.json) already carries wall/cpu/rss plus brief_bytes (T520) — duplicating them there would fork one fact into two stores. Join key for scope→wall: task id + attempt; the kanban row's `claim_count` is its attempt counter, and the runner's run record carries `task` (= task id) + `attempt`. Three mechanical fields (brief_bytes = bundle file byte size, computed at dispatch/claim; files_in_scope = count of unique deliverables= + holds= paths; expected_wall_s = --expected-wall <secs>, null/UNKNOWN when absent, never 0) plus the ruling-35 scope enumeration (--scope-targets a,b,c → scope_enumerable=true; --scope-unenumerable <reason> → scope_enumerable=false + scope_note; neither → scope_enumerable=null = UNKNOWN, never rendered as 0 or full marks). ONE REAL ROW CARRYING SCOPE — T627 itself, dispatched with the new binary (`bin/managent dispatch T627 --to deepseek-v4-pro --expected-wall 1800 --scope-targets 'brief_bytes,files_in_scope,expected_wall_s,scope-enumeration,test,show-display,findings'`): {"brief_bytes":3958,"files_in_scope":2,"expected_wall_s":1800,"scope_enumerable":true,"scope_targets":["brief_bytes","files_in_scope","expected_wall_s","scope-enumeration","test","show-display","findings"],"scope_note":null}. files_in_scope=2 is correct: T627's bundle declares deliverables=src/managent/main.zig,findings/T627-scope-field.json and holds=src/managent/main.zig; the meta-header deliverables= takes precedence over the body Deliverables: paragraph, so the unique union is {src/managent/main.zig, findings/T627-scope-field.json}. Verification: 3 tests added (scope enumerated round-trip, scope unenumerable round-trip, old-row-parses-to-UNKNOWN) — all green under `zig test src/managent/main.zig` (20/20 with T636's 8), wired into `zig build test` via the existing managent_tests step (build.zig:154); test isolation per T427 (parseStateJson/serializeState round-trips only, never the live store). End-to-end smoke against a MANAGENT_STORE scratch store confirmed dispatch writes + show displays + claim fills brief_bytes/files_in_scope (expected_wall_s and scope stay UNKNOWN when no dispatch made a statement) and the error paths (--expected-wall 0 refused; --scope-targets + --scope-unenumerable mutually exclusive refused). docs/infra/managent/spec.md updated with the new dispatch flags, the stored field semantics, and the show output. Non-goals honoured: no backfill (old rows parse to null = UNKNOWN); no scope taxonomy frozen (buckets derive at report time from the mechanical fields). Landmark: advances L1 (measurement integrity) — a future analyst can now separate 'this model fails audits' from 'this model fails repo-wide audits', because the denominator (the enumerated scope) is recorded at dispatch and never reconstructed retroactively.
